title: Sigmoid Layer
source_docs: Deep Learning Toolbox/Deep Learning Layers/Activation Layers/Sigmoid_Layer.md
text: Sigmoid layer, 1 input, 1 output, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Approximation method}, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the data type of output, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action and {Sample time} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Approximation method
params.values: Approximation method for computing layer output None (default) | CORDIC | Lookup

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) |

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Option to specify sample time -1 (default) | scalar
